sources: [S3] Simultrans: Norwegian Localization — Bokmål for B2B software
[S5] terms.json — Norwegian translations analyzed for consistency

falseFriends.performance: 'Ytelse' = speed ratio in OEE, not general capability
falseFriends.station: Use 'arbeidsstasjon' for workstation; 'stasjon' means transport station
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'kassasjon' or 'vrak' for quality rejects, not 'skrot' (metal recycling waste)
falseFriends.order: Use 'arbeidsordre' for production orders, not 'ordre' (commercial order)

grammarNotes.compoundWords: Norwegian forms compounds: 'syklustid' (cycle time), 'nedetid' (downtime). Bokmål spelling differs from DA/SV.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Norwegian compound words inherently use singular modifier stems. Compound formation handles modifier singularity by construction. No compound pluralization issue.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE acronym is used directly. No established Norwegian acronym.
industryContext.dominantSectors: Petroleum/energy (Equinor), maritime (Kongsberg), metals (Norsk Hydro), fish farming, fertilizer (Yara)

commonMistakes: Using 'De' instead of 'du' — 'De' has 'more or less disappeared'; 'du' correct for all software
Mixing Bokmål and Nynorsk — use Bokmål exclusively for B2B
Using 'vrak' inconsistently with 'kassasjon' — choose one and be consistent
notes: OEE is used; Bokmål standard for B2B. 'du' is universal. P95 expansion 1.44x. Norwegian egalitarian culture makes informal address non-negotiable.
